question: What qualities characterize the great ground washed by those shining wave waters?
premises: The great ground is washed by shining wave waters.
The ground is described as cool.
These qualities set the visualized setting.
inference: The visualization is set on a cool great ground washed by those shining, wave-filled waters.
uncertainties: The referent of tat in tattaraṅga is context-dependent.
plain_english: Visualize a cool, great ground washed by those shining, wave-filled waters.
